hooks.name: Stop and summarize at milestone boundary

action.prompt:
A spec task was just marked complete. Open .kiro/specs/stoksync/tasks.md and check whether the task just completed is the LAST task listed before that milestone's "Milestone validation" line.

If it IS the last task of its milestone:
1. Do not start any task from the next milestone in this run.
2. Write a concise summary of every file created or modified, and every notable decision made, since the previous milestone checkpoint (use git status/diff if helpful to be accurate).
3. Tell the user the milestone is complete and ready to commit/push to GitHub.
4. Wait for the user's explicit go-ahead before continuing to the next milestone's tasks.

If it is NOT the last task of its milestone, continue normally without interrupting the user.
